tips.text: Alt-fire or heavy attack the Xoris mid-flight to detonate it; a thrown-and-returned Xoris does almost nothing.
Free all three Solaris captives with a charged detonation each; every one adds 20 seconds to the 60-second timer.
Run solo; every extra squad member adds 25 kills to Rank 3 without making you faster.
Max your energy, stand on a rock and use Mesa's Peacemaker to skip the Xoris.
Revenant's Danse Macabre, Octavia's Mallet, Protea, Volt, Saryn and Mirage's Prism also clear it.
In a squad, bring Volt or Wisp for the haste; crossing the map and charging throws is the real constraint.
Bring a Railjack On Call crewmate to clear the room for you.
Run the Void on a crown you already hold, then wait out the Treasurer timer in the same mission to replace it for the next loop.
Bank a handful of crowns of each tier during other content, then burn them in solo runs.
Bring energy pizzas; Errant Specters drop no pickups, so the energy you walk in with is all you get.
Detonate twice on each cluster; the particles of a killed specter hold enemy slots and block new spawns.
Free Solaris captives only inside the Void; freeing ones on the ship first can disable all your abilities in it.
If no Treasurer spawns on Adrastea, switch to Triton.
Farm it together with Protea or Stahlta; the crowns are the shared cost.
Nobody complains about the drops; the cost is one Treasurer kill per crown, and the 75-kill Rank 3 is what fails people.
